name: Azel Radwan
source:
Azel is known as a god in his home country.  His prophecies are always spot on, and the people of Tanzanite worship him deeply.  Nobody has yet seen the beast hidden underneath his perfect persona.

"True love is a curse.  Go throw it away in the desert or something."

[From in-game profile]
